envelope.shape: [version u8, kind u16, correlation u64, causation u64, idempotency str?, digest u64, body bin]; fixed_cost_bytes is the worst-case envelope cost bound (maximal-width integers, bin8 body header); small integers ride as msgpack fixints so actual frames sit below it
envelope.digest: fnv1a-64 over the encoded body bytes
envelope.idempotency_encoding: nil when absent, a bounded utf-8 string when present; nil anywhere else in any frame fails closed on both sides
envelope.stream_prefix: u32 little-endian length of the encoded envelope
